SELECT 'destination' AS search_type, d.id, dt.name AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(dt.short_description, ''), dt.description, '') AS summary, d.created_at, CONCAT('/destinations/', d.id) AS detail_url, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN dt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance FROM destinations d JOIN destination_translations dt ON dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON cc.id = d.region_id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON pcc.id = cc.parent_id WHERE #{type} IN ('all', 'destination') AND ( dt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR dt.short_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR dt.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR cc.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR pcc.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'community' AS search_type, p.id, p.title, p.content AS summary, p.created_at, CONCAT('/post/', p.id) AS detail_url, NULL AS thumbnail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance FROM user_posts p WHERE #{type} IN ('all', 'community') AND p.post_type IN ('QUESTION', 'TIP') AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'course' AS search_type, c.id, c.title, c.content AS summary, c.created_at, CONCAT('/course/', c.id) AS detail_url, NULL AS thumbnail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance FROM courses c WHERE #{type} IN ('all', 'course') AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'travel-info' AS search_type, ti.id, ti.title, ti.content AS summary, ti.created_at, CONCAT('/travel-info/', ti.id) AS detail_url, NULL AS thumbnail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN ti.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance FROM travel_info ti JOIN info_categories ic ON ic.id = ti.category_id AND ic.is_visible = 1 WHERE #{type} IN ('all', 'travel-info') AND ( ti.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR ti.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'event' AS search_type, e.id, e.title, e.description AS summary, e.created_at, CONCAT('/events/', e.id) AS detail_url, COALESCE(NULLIF(e.event_img, ''), NULLIF(e.poster_img, '')) AS thumbnail_url, e.start_date, e.end_date, CASE WHEN e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance FROM events e WHERE #{type} IN ('all', 'event') AND ( e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR e.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'notice' AS search_type, n.id, n.title, n.content AS summary, n.created_at, CONCAT('/support/notices/', n.id) AS detail_url, NULL AS thumbnail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance FROM notices n WHERE #{type} IN ('all', 'notice') AND ( n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
